_doc: FE-C (W9-4/5/7, W9-1) interface strings waiting for their ja (i18n lane). Not part of the catalogue: tools/beta/i18n-fec/merge.py moves them into tools/beta/i18n/en.json together with pending-ja.json in ONE commit (test-i18n requires en and ja to match key for key).

strings.trip.copied: Link copied — it reopens this exact trip.
strings.trip.why.closed.at: Closed — kept for the record, never planned (checked {date})
strings.trip.why.closed: Closed — kept for the record, never planned
strings.trip.why.nopin: No verified pin, so it can’t be put in walking order
strings.trip.why.fit: Didn’t fit in {days} — choose more days to include it
strings.trip.why.gone: No longer listed in a guide
strings.trip.lede: Turn places you saved into a plan of several days: one area a day, at most six stops, nearest next. Closed places never go in, and the trip says why each place was left out.
strings.trip.empty.p: Save places in any guide, then come back to make them a trip. A guide’s own collections work too, from their “Make a trip” link.
strings.trip.forget.label: Forget {name}
strings.trip.from.name: From “{name}”
strings.trip.b.fit: {places} can go in a day, filling at most {days}.
strings.trip.b.none: None of them can go in a day.
strings.trip.b.out: {places} will be left out, each with the reason.
strings.trip.rule: One area a day, at most six stops, nearest next.
strings.trip.fill: Your places fill {days}; more days than that stay empty rather than padded.
strings.trip.name: Name it (optional)
strings.trip.noguide: That guide couldn’t load. Try again when online.
strings.trip.gone.one: 1 place in this link is no longer listed in a guide: {ids}. The link may be older than the guide.
strings.trip.gone: {n} places in this link are no longer listed in a guide: {ids}. The link may be older than the guide.
strings.geo.assume: Walk times are straight-line, about 80 m a minute — an estimate, not a route
strings.trip.hours: Check opening times before you go; the guide doesn’t list them.
strings.trip.noday: No day can be planned from this link: every place in it is closed, unpinned or no longer listed.
strings.trip.sketch: Sketch of day {n}: {stops} in walking order, drawn from the guide’s own pins
strings.rec.label: Recognition
